summary: The market closed lower for a fourth straight day but well off its lows, as late IT-led buying trimmed losses; volatility jumped and smaller stocks took the heaviest damage.

up.summary: IT carried the market through a volatile session and powered the late recovery
up.why: Indian IT rose after the global sell-off in AI-linked shares, offsetting some of the oil-driven selling elsewhere.
